title: The empire's two great explorers, both of al-Ushbūna, push its expeditions forward: ʿAbd al-Jalīl al-Qbasī, an Andalusī of nineteen, and Dom Raimundo Coimbra, a Portuguese Muslim of twenty-six, out on the Eastern Atlantic
